rank_policy: remove strict zero Jacobian columns; check clock-eliminated motion/bias/INS chain nullspace by column-scaled SVD before and after optimization; no added prior
pseudorange_sigma_source: prepared Wen Eq.16 elevation/CN0 covariance; one source correction of satellite clock, atmosphere, TGD and Earth rotation
initialization: sensor-only raw-code WLS per epoch; interpolation only for initial variables, no trajectory prior or output filling; finite-difference WLS velocity; zero body bias

preparation.heading_initialization: one first valid A1 body-yaw plus GNSS1 LLH with Go2/IMU support; fixed world-yaw gauge thereafter
preparation.orientation_formula: R_E_N * Rz(alpha) * D * R_quaternion_wxyz * D * R_install.T
preparation.imu_input: already calibrated current-sample measured-dt FRD increments; do not reapply acceleration scale or installation
preparation.lever_velocity: delta of R_E_B*(omega_body cross lever) at graph interval endpoints
preparation.missing_interval: omit only unsupported INS link; retain graph nodes and code/motion/bias factors; record coverage

engineering_differences: Raw Go2 quaternion is adapted to one globally oriented FRD-to-local-NED AHRS input; not claimed statistically equivalent to XSens Ti10
Source-specific force is converted to body linear acceleration by AHRS gravity removal; normal gravity fixed at sensor-only initial location
Right endpoint Eq3 body bias and Eq25 A_k*dt, with current-state R_GL and full position derivative
Antenna velocity lever change is supplied by measured angular rates and AHRS, a declared physical-point adaptation
Missing raw IMU/AHRS intervals remove INS edges, preserving every graph node and coverage denominator
GPS/BDS epoch clocks assigned only when observed; no extra Doppler/yaw/pose factor or author performance/latency claim
